about: Modwerk source-only sample-layer (Sample Layer) package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/sample-layer.

mods.title: Sample Layer
mods.summary: Sample engines for the SMPL key: FUNC + SMPL picks SAMPLER (stock) or TRANSIENT for each sound.
mods.description: TRANSIENT shapes a track's sample alone, before its DAC: a punch or a soft attack, a decay, a band (BAS and WID) and a shift of up to 30 ms after the analog voice. The analog machine, filter and AMP envelope are left as they are, and the engine and its settings are saved with the sound.
mods.author: chevyone
mods.on_unit: The same source ran on the author's Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 in build SL20 (RAM-booted on a development base with a USB test link, 28 November 2026): the engine list, TRANSIENT's page and its controls, reported working by the author. This package has not run on a unit.
